title: Single day or range
text: Select one day, or a range with minimum and maximum lengths.

title: Business calendar
text: Weekends and holidays are marked and can be made unselectable.

title: Several months
text: Shows up to three months side by side.

title: Week numbers
text: Optional ISO week numbers and a configurable first day of the week.

title: Full keyboard support
text: Arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down, Home and End move through the grid.
